manifest.retrieval: Zep Cloud published retrieval context, verbatim from zep_locomo_search_results.json

judge.note: full prompt text in data/head_to_head/judge.json (identical for every store)

deviations: context is theirs; reader+judge are ours (that is the point of the comparison)
qa_id canonicalised to full-qa-list indices (their rows index the cat-5-filtered list)
limits: Artifacts verify the RESULT, not the SYSTEM: they let a third party re-read and re-judge our retrieval, not rebuild the store.
Single run. OpenAI is not bit-deterministic at temperature 0; observed drift between identical reruns is ~0.3-0.4pt.
